knobs.note: BH-938. Read by bin/issue-state-ledger.sh as ${ISSUE_STATE_BACKFILL_DAYS:-14}: how far back a project with no issue_state_wm watermark row starts reading its GitHub issues. It only has to exceed the 7-day DEAD archive window in console-ui/functions/api/dash/kanban/pipeline.js; a non-numeric value falls back to 14.

BH-938. Read by bin/issue-state-ledger.sh as ${ISSUE_STATE_MAX_PUTS:-300}: the most issue_state ledger rows one tick writes across all projects. Past it the watermark is persisted, a DEFERRED line is logged and the next tick resumes; a non-numeric value falls back to 300.

BH-938. Read by bin/issue-state-ledger.sh as ${ISSUE_STATE_MAX_PAGES:-10}: the most 100-item GitHub issue pages one tick reads per project. Past it the watermark is persisted and a DEFERRED line is logged; a non-numeric value falls back to 10.
